components.institution_label: Policy on Parental Teaching Relief for Tenured and Tenure-Track Faculty
components.description: One semester of relief from classroom teaching, without a reduction in salary, for tenured and tenure-track faculty who give birth or become parents of a newborn or newly adopted child under six; research, graduate supervision and other duties continue. Up to two periods, for separate births or adoptions.

components.entitlement_note: V2: the policy provides the semester 'upon request'; the dean decides how teaching is modified (arrangements), not whether relief is given.
components.relief_note: Relief from assigned classroom teaching; the policy states that the faculty member's other professional responsibilities, including research and graduate student supervision, continue (stated, not inferred).

components.dual_employee_rule: each may take one semester (both parents in eligible positions)
components.notice: Written request to the dean with as much advance notice as is possible

Version: 2018_00 (teaching relief) is dated (effective 2011-10-05, footer 10/29/2014) but the saved copy is a Wayback capture of 2016-09-09, before the reference academic year; no later version is saved and no saved source contradicts it; treated as in force. The 2018_06 compiled handbook's Tenure section matches 2018_02 apart from wording.

Cross-references not saved: Benefits and Services Handbook (Maternity/Adoption Leave, Family Leave, Sick Leave policies, cited by the handbook Tenure section); HRM policies on Maternity/Adoption Leave, Family Leave and Sick Leave (handbook 'consult Human Resources Management'); Policy on Probationary Period; Disability Benefits Program Description; LTD Certificate of Coverage; Family and Medical Leave policy (listed as related to the teaching-relief policy); the HR FMLA rights notice; Policy on Leaves of Absence (CA); Policy on Timekeeping and Reporting; the Massachusetts Earned Sick Time Law text.

No paid parental or childbirth leave exists in the saved sources: Leaves of Absence are unpaid; employees may use accrued sick time (c4, an employer allotment under R1) for an approved medical leave and vacation (12-month faculty only, c8); interim disability (c6) pays 60% after 30 days' absence once sick time is exhausted. The HR leaves page lists 'Maternity/Adoption Leave'; the governing policy's matching provision is the Parental Leave of Absence (c2).

Paid sick time band (U8): 'Up to 2 years of completed service 22 days'; 'Over 2 years ... 44 days'. A member with two years of completed service falls in the first band (22 days, 4.4 weeks); 44 days recorded in duration_max.

Birth parent chain: parental leave 8 weeks (unpaid) with FMLA 12 weeks alongside from the start (S1); paid sick time 22 days → interim disability 60% up to 6 months (after 30 days' absence, sick time exhausted) → LTD from day 181; one semester of classroom teaching relief at full salary also available, after the leave and the sick time (R3d, within 12 months of the birth). Links: c3 concurrent_with c2; c6 consecutive_after c4; c7 consecutive_after c6; c1 also_available c2 and c4.

Non-birth parent chain: parental leave 8 weeks (8 weeks in the aggregate if both parents work for the University) with FMLA 12 weeks alongside; up to 40 hours of sick time for family care (c5, unlinked); one semester of classroom teaching relief also available after the leave (R3d). No component is linked two ways.

Tenure clock: the Policy on Tenure Clock Extension grants one year for a birth or adoption on request (c14; automatic for recipients of teaching relief per 2018_00, while the 2017 policy says HRM-approved leaves do not independently extend the clock and a written request is still required); the handbook Tenure section separately makes a delay automatic after a maternity leave of a full term or more (c17). Both kept; they overlap.

Not components: sabbatical and professional leaves (career-related, not usable for a birth); military, jury and bereavement leave; Small Necessities leave (school and routine appointments); research faculty provisional-funding leave (funding lapses).
Calendar: semester stated without a length : calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

statutory_floor.statute: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (29 U.S.C. 2611-2612)
